definitions.capture_near_occlusion: capture while the prey is near an occlusion
definitions.capture_other: capture without a more specific spatial/temporal label
definitions.goal_overshoot: approached within 0.15 then ended at least 0.08 farther away
definitions.late_predator_response: capture within four steps of first predator visibility
definitions.navigation_oscillation: timeout with A/B/A action alternation score >= 0.45
definitions.open_space_capture: capture away from walls and occlusions
definitions.stuck_timeout: timeout with <= 0.03 path length over the final 20 steps
definitions.timeout_other: timeout not matched by another deterministic rule
definitions.wrong_way_navigation: final goal distance at least 0.10 worse than start
